description: Fig. 4 is a ten-panel composite TEM figure on precipitates in a Fe–Mn–Al–C austenitic low-density steel, arranged as three rows of bright-field (BF) images, centred dark-field (DF) images and selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns. Every micrograph carries a 100 nm scale bar; every SAED pattern carries a 2 1/nm scale bar. Row 1, Ti- and V-free sample M1-30: (a) BF image with dense speckled dark contrast; (b) DF image resolving a high density of uniformly distributed fine bright particles labelled 'κ' in red; (c) SAED with zone axis ZA=[0 1̄ 1], yellow-ringed matrix reflections (111), (200), (111) and red-ringed extra reflections from κ. Row 2, M2-10: (d) BF image showing discrete dark faceted particles; (e) DF image with a blue arrow labelled '(Ti, V) C' and a red arrow labelled 'κ' pointing to the same precipitate, κ at the (Ti,V)C edge; (f) SAED with ZA=[1̄ 1̄ 0], yellow labels (1 1̄ 1̄), (2 2̄ 0), (1 1 1), plus blue '(Ti, V)C' and red κ circles. Row 3, M2-30: (g) BF image with heterogeneous dark bands; (h) DF image of κ (red label); (i) DF image of (Ti, V) C (blue label); (j) SAED with ZA=[100] and labelled (020), (022), (002). Together the panels demonstrate that κ-carbide is dense and uniform in M1-30 but sparse, heterogeneous and attached to (Ti, V)C in M2 steel.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a BF TEM image of M1-30 with a 100 nm scale bar and shows a dense speckled dark contrast typical of a high number density of fine precipitates.
Panel (b) is a DF TEM image of M1-30 in which the precipitates imaged are labelled 'κ' in red and appear as fine bright dots uniformly distributed across the field.

Panel (c) is an SAED pattern of M1-30 with a 2 1/nm scale bar, zone axis ZA=[0 1̄ 1]; yellow circles label the reflections (111), (200) and (111), while red circles mark extra reflections consistent with a second (κ) phase.
Panel (e) shows a DF image of M2-10 in which a blue arrow labelled '(Ti, V) C' and a red arrow labelled 'κ' point to the same precipitate, indicating κ located at the edge of a (Ti, V)C particle.
Panel (f) SAED pattern of M2-10 has zone axis ZA=[1̄ 1̄ 0] with yellow-labelled reflections (1 1̄ 1̄), (2 2̄ 0) and (1 1 1), plus blue circles labelled '(Ti, V)C' and red circles assigned to κ.
Panel (g) BF image of M2-30 shows precipitates grouped into heterogeneous dark bands rather than a uniform dispersion; scale bar 100 nm.
Panels (h) and (i) are dark-field images of M2-30 selecting κ (red label 'κ') and (Ti, V) C (blue label '(Ti, V) C') respectively, both appearing at matched heterogeneous locations.
Panel (j) SAED pattern of M2-30 has zone axis ZA=[100] with yellow-labelled (020), (022), (002) reflections and overlapping blue (Ti, V)C and red κ circles.

The caption states the panels are (a) BF image of κ in M1-30, (b) DF image of κ in M1-30, (c) SAED of κ in M1-30, (d) BF and (e) DF of κ and (Ti, V)C in M2-10, (g) BF, (h) DF of κ, (i) DF of (Ti, V)C and (j) SAED of M2-30.

The caption labels two different panels as '(e)' (the second should be the SAED pattern of M2-10), so the lettering in the caption is inconsistent while the visible panel letters run (a)-(j) continuously.
The citing text states that the κ-carbides in the Ti- and V-free M1 steel aged 30 h have a number density of around 7 × 10^22 m^-3 and are uniformly distributed.
The citing text states that in M2-10 the precipitation of κ-carbide is limited and it preferentially precipitates at the edge of (Ti, V)C carbides, with almost no κ-carbides in the matrix.
The citing text states that in M2-30 the κ-carbides show increased number density and larger size than the 10 h aged sample, while the distribution remains heterogeneous.

subfigures.description: BF TEM micrograph of sample M1-30 (label in yellow at top-right), 100 nm scale bar, showing dense fine speckled dark contrast from a high density of small precipitates.
DF TEM micrograph of M1-30, 100 nm scale bar; a very high number density of fine bright particles is uniformly distributed; the red letter 'κ' marks the imaged precipitate.
SAED pattern of M1-30, 2 1/nm scale bar, zone axis labelled ZA=[0 1̄ 1]; yellow circles mark matrix reflections (111), (200), (111) and red circles mark additional κ reflections.
BF TEM micrograph of M2-10, 100 nm scale bar; discrete dark faceted particles sparsely distributed in a bright matrix.
DF TEM micrograph of M2-10, 100 nm scale bar; a blue arrow labelled '(Ti, V) C' points to a bright particle, and a red arrow labelled 'κ' points to its edge.
SAED pattern of M2-10, 2 1/nm scale bar, ZA=[1̄ 1̄ 0]; yellow-circled reflections labelled (1 1̄ 1̄), (2 2̄ 0), (1 1 1), with blue circles labelled '(Ti, V)C' and red circles for κ.
BF TEM micrograph of M2-30, 100 nm scale bar; dark precipitates arranged in heterogeneous, band-like or stringer groupings rather than a uniform dispersion.
DF TEM micrograph of M2-30, 100 nm scale bar, selecting κ reflections; bright κ particles (red label 'κ') are clustered heterogeneously.
DF TEM micrograph of M2-30, 100 nm scale bar, selecting (Ti, V)C reflections (blue label '(Ti, V) C'); bright carbide particles appear at the same heterogeneously distributed positions.
SAED pattern of M2-30, 2 1/nm scale bar, ZA=[100]; yellow-circled reflections labelled (020), (022), (002) with blue '(Ti, V)C' and red κ circles.
